block.description: Whom to block, and from what.

repo.description: The one repository to block it from, by its dev.knotless.repo record: one of the asker's own. All of them when absent.

subject.description: The account to block, by DID or handle.

blockState.description: Whether the account is blocked now, from what was asked.

main.description: Writes a dev.knotless.block record in the account logged in to this appview's web pages, as `knotless mod block` does, unless one is there already: nothing the account blocked writes about its repositories, or about the one repository named, shows. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account. Clients holding their own session write the record themselves.

errors.description: The account is the one asking, or the repository is not its own.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

description: Blocks an account as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
